item.title: Govt approves 19,983 health infrastructure units under PM-ABHIM
item.description: The government has approved a significant number of health infrastructure units aimed at enhancing public health services. This initiative specifically targets disease surveillance, emergency preparedness, and healthcare delivery alongside critical care capabilities. Established through the Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission, it seeks to bolster the healthcare framework across the country. item.title: Hetero begins shipments of generic HIV prevention drug to Africa
item.description: Hetero has initiated shipments of generic lenacapavir to Africa and plans to supply 300,000 vials to Zambia, Uganda, and Zimbabwe. The World Health Organization recommended lenacapavir as an HIV prevention option after successful clinical trials. Generic versions of the drug are being produced by six licensed drugmakers, including Hetero, to enhance accessibility in low-income regions.

item.title: Cipla, Teva get USFDA nod for first generic Flovent HFA asthma inhaler
item.description: Cipla announced the approval of Fluticasone HFA metered dose inhaler for asthma treatment by the US health regulator. This marks the first generic equivalent to Flovent HFA, expanding treatment options for patients aged four and older. The product was developed in collaboration with Teva Pharmaceuticals, who will handle its commercialization in the US. The US market for this medication is valued at approximately USD 350 million.

item.title: Economic Times – Leadership & Wellness Feature
item.description: With over 14 years of experience as a neurosurgeon, Dr. Sai launched Vaidya Healthtech to revolutionize healthcare efficiency. He aims to build a connected healthcare ecosystem for secure patient information management. Understanding the significance of personal health, he highlights fitness practices as vital for well-being and encourages individuals to view fitness as a necessary commitment amidst their busy lives.

item.title: Economic Times – Leadership, Health & Fitness Profile
item.description: Dr. Papishetty is a pioneer in comprehensive women's healthcare, addressing often neglected issues in conventional medicine. She champions the fusion of fertility care with cosmetic gynaecology while shining a light on underdiagnosed conditions. Her path underscores the importance of achieving balance, urging professionals to maintain their health amidst busy lives. By promoting consistency in fitness, she fosters resilience, empowering women to tackle health issues openly and confidently.
